theme: Early secretory pathway ER-Golgi vesicle traffic
core_role: The shared COPI budding, ER-exit-site and retrograde pathways serve as the Golgi-to-ER retrieval arm that recycles machinery and escaped ER proteins, complementing the COPII-driven ER export of cargo.

theme: Acid-base anion and proton exchange across membranes
core_role: The shared bicarbonate transporters and their SLC4 disease defects are the core bicarbonate-handling arm of systemic and cellular pH regulation, alongside SLC26 anion exchangers, NHE proton exchangers and carbonic anhydrase.

theme: Branching morphogenesis of glandular and respiratory epithelia
core_role: The shared pathways cast mammary and prostate (and reproductive) gland development as instances of epithelial branching and glandular differentiation, driven by the same mesenchymal-epithelial FGF signalling that builds lung, salivary and lacrimal glands.

theme: Early kidney development: nephric duct to nephron induction
core_role: The shared pathways frame the metanephric mesenchyme's side of kidney formation, maintaining nephron progenitors and converting them to epithelial tubules in response to induction by the ureteric bud.

theme: Phospholipid synthesis, remodelling and membrane distribution
core_role: The shared pathways cover the movement of phospholipids between and across membranes, flipping and scrambling and intermembrane transfer that distribute the newly synthesised and remodelled PS, PE, PC, PG and cardiolipin.

theme: Rho-family GTPase signalling to actin protrusions
core_role: The shared GTPase cycles of CDC42, RHOG, RAC3 and RHOJ are the switching core of small-GTPase signalling that, through WASP/WAVE and Arp2/3, drives lamellipodia and actin-based protrusion.

theme: Glycerophospholipid biosynthesis and acyl-chain remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are the de novo synthesis routes for PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin via CDP-choline and CDP-diacylglycerol, which the theme frames as the starting point for Lands-cycle remodelling, hydrolysis and lipid transfer.

theme: Kidney organogenesis: ureteric bud and nephron development
core_role: The shared pathways describe the ureteric bud and mesonephric duct side of early kidney formation, its outgrowth, elongation and branching, which induces nephron formation from the metanephric mesenchyme.

theme: Cellular energy buffering and glycolytic ATP supply
core_role: The shared creatine/phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange pathways form the phosphocreatine shuttle that buffers and distributes ATP, here framed alongside glycolytic and fermentative ATP production.

theme: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and peroxisome function
core_role: The shared pathways capture peroxisome biology itself (fission, TYSND1 protease processing, NAD transport, medium-chain acyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA handling) as the organelle housekeeping that supports peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation.

theme: RUNX-driven transcriptional control of myeloid granulopoiesis
core_role: The shared RUNX1/RUNX2/RUNX3 transcriptional programmes act as the master transcriptional regulators of myeloid and neutrophil lineage commitment that G-CSF signalling and granulopoietic factors carry forward.

theme: Mechanoresponsive fibroblast and stromal matrix programme
core_role: The shared pathways describe YAP/TAZ-mediated mechanotransduction and focal adhesion signalling that convert mechanical and TGF-beta cues into fibroblast activation and matrix remodelling.

theme: Actin filament turnover in cell shape and protrusion
core_role: The shared pathways are the disassembly side of actin dynamics, severing, depolymerisation, capping and Arp2/3 inhibition, which balance polymerisation to remodel filopodia, ruffles and cell polarity.

theme: Antigen presentation and cytotoxic lymphocyte regulation
core_role: The shared pathways frame dendritic cells and monocytes as antigen-presenting cells, including CD1 lipid presentation, that prime T cells and engage NK/NKT cells within a broader MHC presentation and cytotoxicity network.

theme: Neutrophil granule biology and antimicrobial effector response
core_role: The shared pathways describe neutrophil degranulation and myeloid effector activation, the release of the antimicrobial granule cargo that neutrophils build during maturation and deploy on formyl-peptide-guided recruitment.

theme: DNA repair synthesis, replication and translesion synthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the DNA polymerase machinery, replication fork synthesis, PCNA-based polymerase switching, translesion synthesis and gap filling, framed as the synthesis step common to excision, mismatch and other DNA repair pathways.

theme: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting after injury
core_role: The shared pathways frame the positive and negative control of injured-axon regrowth, including RHOA-mediated growth inhibition, within broader regulation of axon cytoskeleton and branching.

theme: DNA damage checkpoints and homologous recombination repair
core_role: The shared pathways describe checkpoint signalling, p53-driven repair gene expression and resolution of recombination intermediates that maintain genome stability, framing them as the control layer over homologous recombination repair.

theme: Mitotic spindle assembly, centrosome maturation and cytokinesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe centrosome maturation and Aurora A/TPX2-driven spindle assembly at mitotic entry, the early mitotic step that precedes spindle elongation, midzone assembly and cytokinesis.

theme: Protein glycosylation and nucleotide-sugar metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the N-glycan processing and elongation steps, mannose trimming, antennae elongation, sialylation and poly-LacNAc addition, which consume the nucleotide sugars whose synthesis, transport and disease defects fill out the theme.

theme: Vitamin K, quinone metabolism and gamma-carboxylation
core_role: The shared pathways describe the metabolism of vitamin K and related quinones (menaquinone, ubiquinol), which here serves as the cofactor supply for gamma-carboxylation of coagulation proteins.

theme: Inositol phosphate signalling and PI3K/AKT regulation
core_role: The shared pathways cover nuclear phosphoinositide and inositol pyrophosphate synthesis plus oncogenic AKT1 activation, framed as the lipid-messenger signalling that feeds and regulates the PI3K/AKT/PTEN axis.

theme: Metanephric mesenchyme survival and nephron differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways describe maintenance, survival and mesenchymal-to-epithelial conversion of nephron progenitors, framed as the controls on kidney growth, size and tubular differentiation.

theme: Golgi vesicle trafficking and Golgi organisation
core_role: The shared COPI-dependent vesicle budding and retrograde/anterograde transport pathways are the core vesicle traffic that maintains Golgi structure, retention and secretion, including its disassembly and reassembly.

theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
core_role: The shared pathways describe insertion of proteins into the inner mitochondrial membrane and assembly of complexes I and III, the biogenesis step that builds the electron transport chain for oxidative phosphorylation.

theme: NK cell activation and inhibitory receptor tolerance
core_role: The shared pathways describe KIR-mediated inhibitory control of NK activation and tolerance, framed as the regulation of NK cytotoxicity and granzyme killing by MHC class I recognition.

theme: B cell development, activation and plasma cell differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell identity, BCR signalling, proliferation and differentiation, framed as the core lymphocyte programme driving germinal centre, memory and plasma cell responses.

theme: Eicosanoid and lipid mediator biosynthesis in inflammation
core_role: The shared pathways describe arachidonic acid release and the cyclooxygenase/P450 prostaglandin and thromboxane branch with its receptors, one arm of lipid mediator signalling alongside leukotrienes and pro-resolving mediators.

theme: Hepatic carbohydrate metabolism: fructose, glycerol, glucose and glycogen
core_role: The shared pathways describe fructose and glycerol/polyol metabolism and its inherited defects, framed as entry routes feeding glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen metabolism.

theme: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and antiviral type I interferon
core_role: The shared pathways describe IRF3- and ZBP1-mediated induction of type I interferon and AIM2 regulation, the antiviral output of cytosolic DNA sensing via cGAS/STING.

theme: Amyloid-beta clearance and amyloid fibril formation
core_role: The shared pathways describe regulation of amyloid-beta clearance by cellular degradation, the removal side that counterbalances amyloid fibril formation.

theme: Epithelial nutrient transport: hexoses and amino acids
core_role: The shared pathways describe intestinal digestion and absorption of dietary sugars and hexose transport by SLC2/SLC5 carriers and their disorders, framed as one part of epithelial solute transport in gut and kidney together with amino acid and organic anion carriers.

theme: Platelet activation and blood coagulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe platelet activation by thrombin and ADP receptors and platelet degranulation, the cellular arm of hemostasis that works together with coagulation, VWF adhesion and fibrinolysis.

theme: Fibroblast adhesion, cytoskeletal tension and matrix remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways describe focal adhesion, stress fibre and SRF-driven cytoskeletal signalling, framed as the mechanotransductive drivers of fibroblast migration, EMT and extracellular matrix assembly.

theme: Actin cytoskeleton dynamics in cell migration
core_role: The shared pathways describe Rho GTPase-driven actin nucleation through WASP/WAVE, Arp2/3 and formins forming lamellipodia, the protrusive engine of cell motility and macropinocytosis.

theme: Circadian and nuclear receptor control of metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe the circadian clock and nuclear receptor transcription (PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB, PGC-1alpha), framed as transcriptional control of metabolism and mitochondrial biogenesis in response to nutrient and redox state.

theme: Glycoconjugate biosynthesis: sialic acid, GPI anchors, glycosphingolipids
core_role: The shared pathways describe the synthesis of nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid) and their use to build GPI anchors and glycosphingolipids, with their Golgi transport and congenital glycosylation disorders.

theme: LXR-mediated regulation of lipid and triglyceride metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) transcriptional control of lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis, the nuclear receptor regulation of energy homeostasis integrated with insulin, AMPK and adiponectin signalling.

theme: Dicarboxylate transport and glutamate/nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe sodium-coupled transport of succinate and other di- and tricarboxylates, framed as the movement of TCA intermediates that link to glutamate/glutamine metabolism, the malate-aspartate shuttle and nitrogen handling.

theme: Hexosamine pathway and sialic acid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe the hexosamine biosynthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and its congenital myasthenic defects (GFPT1, ALG14), the precursor supply for sialic acid synthesis.

theme: Dendritic cell cytokine responses driving Th1 immunity
core_role: The shared pathways describe dendritic cell cytokine and chemokine production in response to pathogens and STING signalling, framed as the innate priming that drives IL-12, IFN-gamma and Th1 responses.

theme: Mitotic spindle formation and centrosome regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe Aurora A- and PLK1-regulated centrosome maturation and spindle assembly at the G2/M transition, framed as the core of mitotic progression including centrosome duplication and spindle checkpoint control.

theme: Catecholamine synthesis and monoamine neurotransmitter transport
core_role: The shared pathways describe dopamine synthesis and catecholamine transport and reuptake, framed as monoaminergic neurotransmission involving SLC6 transporters, vesicular loading and norepinephrine release.

theme: B-vitamin and one-carbon micronutrient metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe riboflavin and thiamine transport and metabolism, choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis, framed as part of water-soluble vitamin and one-carbon metabolism with folate, cobalamin and methionine cycling.

theme: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways describe copper and manganese uptake, homeostasis and detoxification, including ceruloplasmin deficiency, framed as metal handling linked to iron export defects in hemochromatosis.

theme: Microglial neuroinflammation in amyloid neurodegeneration
core_role: The shared pathways describe microglial activation, proliferation and cytotoxicity in response to amyloid-beta, with neuronal death and impaired synaptic plasticity, framed as glial neuroinflammation in Alzheimer-type pathology.

theme: Chromatin modification and epigenetic gene silencing
core_role: The shared pathways describe histone lysine methylation by WDR5/MLL (KMT2) complexes, framed as one epigenetic layer alongside DNA methylation, PRC2, heterochromatin, imprinting and retroelement silencing.

theme: FGF receptor signalling cascades
core_role: The shared pathways describe FGFR4 signalling via FRS2/SHC to MAPK and betaKlotho-dependent ligand binding, framed as one receptor's arm within FGFR family PI3K and PLC-gamma signalling.
